findings.name: label_continuation_differs_from_repeated_wait_policy
findings.evidence: late profitable and late harmful entry both label zero; current zero-score policy posts neither
findings.implication: The score estimates the benefit of a 50ms head start under forced neutral continuation, not the value of admission versus continuing to wait. Changing >0 to >=0 alone admits both cases.

findings.name: repeated_wait_states_are_not_in_training_population
findings.evidence: neutral policy posts on the first legal opportunity; generation gets one entry row. Runtime can decide repeatedly with different inventory/book/price while remaining empty.
findings.implication: Need causal support for empty-slot continuation states and shared post-decision policy; no optimal-waiting interpretation.

findings.name: abandoned_launcher_left_false_waiting_state
findings.evidence: PID2030852 absent, no full rows or models, waiting status still present, size driver1576587 remained stopped
findings.repair: bounded diagnostic uses user systemd service with identity-checked ExecStopPost resume hook; original status superseded without deleting artifacts

findings.name: acceptance_does_not_test_incremental_timing_skill
findings.evidence: development_screen combines relative PNL, absolute positivity and inventory; local_null is printed but not part of the predicate; there is no participation-matched portfolio null
findings.implication: Even a pass is a descriptive policy comparison, not evidence of superior entry selection.

findings.name: support_gate_allows_constant_timing_head
findings.evidence: pilot ask trained on424 actions (36 nonzero), min_data_in_leaf200 and bagging_fraction0.8; saved model has1 tree/1 leaf and posts on all65 labeled test actions
findings.implication: Current200-action threshold does not ensure a head can split. Require actual model capacity/variation diagnostics, and sufficient training data before interpreting timing skill.

sanitized client state and received-book features; pending quantities reserve capacity
paired branch prefix equality; common terminal cash+inventory accounting
result populations include flat/no-fill windows; source/model/inference hashes
recommended_target: Q(POST,state)-Q(WAIT,state) under the same frozen continuation policy, allowing repeated waiting; include an absolute admission-value/never-post control; collect causal empty-slot continuation support and exclude each test day through the entire training chain
performance_status: bounded diagnostic complete; full chronological study not launched; candidate not advanced
interpretation: The existing target is valid as a one-step policy-improvement diagnostic under its declared neutral continuation. It is not a complete admission/optimal-stopping model. The review finding concerns applying it repeatedly outside that continuation and support, not a claim that every zero one-step advantage must cause economic loss.
